What people struggled with most

03 · Value proposition · Today vs. Grid

Today, the tools are separate and Grid connects those gaps.

Today

A disconnected process

- LinkedIn stores contacts.
- Notes hold details.
- AI can suggest questions.

But you still have to piece it all together.

Grid

A reason to reconnect

Grid helps you prepare, remember what you learned and follow up, while building skills through real conversations.

Why AI earns its place

Helpful suggestions, your choice

AI helps turn your goals into questions and your notes into useful takeaways. You review and decide what to use

04 · Live demo · Human vs. AI controlNothing executes

AI helps you prepare. You stay in control.

Human decides

You decide

You choose your goal, edit the questions, decide what to save and send your own follow-up.

✦ AI proposes

AI suggests

It suggests questions, summarizes your notes and drafts follow-ups. If it lacks evidence, it says so.

AI executes

No automatic actions

Grid does not send messages, post, use your calendar, record conversations or rate other people.

07
04 · Live demo · When the AI is wrong

If AI gets it wrong, you can change it.

Edit

If a suggested question sounds awkward, rewrite it or remove it before your conversation.

Not enough info

If Grid cannot support a skill assessment with your notes, it says “Not enough info”.

✦ Labelled

AI suggestions are labelled so you know what to review.

08
05 · Success metrics · North Star

North Star: completed conversation loops.

A chat that was prepared, debriefed and followed up within 7 days. It measures the need itself: remembered, and in touch. Sign-ups and page views don’t count. The AI-graded “Skill Advances” metric is gone.

06 · Risks and next steps · Risk, ask, Weeks 8–11
Biggest risk

AI could make conversations feel scripted.

We let users change every suggestion and practise in their own words, rather than memorizing a script.

The seams

Some parts are still simulated.

AI is in mock mode. Discover uses sample data. Database, payments and usage limits still need testing. Three tests need updates.

Our ask

Does our North Star measure real relationships, or just people completing steps?

Weeks 8–11

8  Test with 3 users; interview 2 more people
9  Test real AI responses and evidence-based feedback
10  Address privacy for people added as contacts
11  Track completed loops and test onboarding

First commitment after Reading Week: Run the three-person C1 study and document the results.
